about: Gold for evals/multi-page/run.ts. gold: multi = the piece continues and must be followed; single = it must not be; either = a borderline a reader could want either way, reported apart. pages: the other pages of the piece, page 1 left out, in order. complete: whether pages is every one of them; when false, scoring counts recall over the listed pages only and does not count other picks against precision. Collected 2026-10-24 (report spya-qkyukr).
